description: checks added after the test rows were scored; none of them changes the selected model or its thresholds

equal_workload.rule: median over the tuned models of the test flag rate at each model's out-of-fold capacity threshold

oof_cutoffs.rule: cut-off = k-th highest out-of-fold score of the open-at-filing training reports, k = round(share x scored rows); a test report is flagged when its score >= cut-off

knn.note: n_neighbors extended beyond the edge of 51 of the original grid

random_forest.note: all 24 points of the grid that RandomizedSearchCV sampled four of

hist_gb.note: min_samples_leaf replaces the inert max_iter dimension and max_leaf_nodes adds 63
